description.value: A Subway franchise located on Kingsway in Vancouver's Renfrew-Collingwood neighbourhood, offering made-to-order sandwiches, wraps, and salads with pickup, delivery, and curbside options. The location serves breakfast and offers catering, making it a flexible stop for groups or individuals on a longer route. As an independently owned franchise, it operates under the Subway brand while being a local business.
